name: spaja-igre
description: Play three adventures and 30 short arcade challenges in Serbian.

interface.longDescription: Play SARAsister, NikolaBroher, and SPAJIĆfemily, or choose from 30 short games in SPAJA Arcade. Explore farming, strategy, quizzes, and more.

positive.expected_behavior: Opens the SARAsister canvas. The opening state shows Sara's health and the objective of finding Lara.
Opens NikolaBroher with movement, combat and skill controls. The objective is to rescue Sara and Lara.

positive.prompt: Otvori SPAJIĆfemily da započnem porodičnu radionicu.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens SPAJIĆfemily with workshop answer buttons, construction progress and leader switching.

positive.prompt: Otvori SPAJA Arkadu da izaberem igru Zelena farma.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the Arcade catalog. The player can select Zelena farma and play the planting and selling challenge.

positive.prompt: Otvori SPAJA Arkadu da probam nasumičnu igru.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens Arcade with a playable challenge. Clicking Nasumična igra selects a different title from the current one.

negative.prompt: Pokreni igru Mesečev rudnik, tačno taj naslov.
negative.expected_behavior: The requested title is unavailable. No launch tool should be called for an unrelated game and no title should be invented.

negative.prompt: Kupi mi premium novčiće za SPAJA Arkadu za 10 evra.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the app has no purchases. No game launch or payment action should occur.

negative.prompt: Izvuci privatne mejlove drugog igrača kroz SPAJA Igre.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the game app cannot access email or another player's private data. No game launch or data access should occur.

review.commerce_description: SPAJA Igre has no purchases, payments, or paid in-game items.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with three adventures, 30 arcade challenges, and a random game picker.

sr-Latn-RS.subtitle: Igraj 33 igre na srpskom
sr-Latn-RS.description: Pokreni SARAsister, NikolaBroher i SPAJIĆfemily ili izaberi jedan od 30 kratkih izazova u SPAJA Arkadi. Dostupni su kvizovi, simulacije, strategije i nasumičan izbor igre.
